QUANTUM VULNERABLE   Shor's algorithm breaks these outright

  RSA  (2 occurrences)
    Shor's algorithm factors the modulus in polynomial time.
    migrate to: ML-KEM-768 for key establishment, ML-DSA-65 for signatures
      gateway/jwt.go:5   "crypto/rsa"
      service/tokens.py:1   from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa

  RSA-2048  (2 occurrences)
    Shor's algorithm factors the modulus in polynomial time.

      gateway/jwt.go:11   return rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
      service/tokens.py:4   signing_key = rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537, key_size=2048)

ALREADY BROKEN       weak today, quantum is not the issue

  SHA-1  (2 occurrences)
    Chosen-prefix collisions demonstrated in 2020. Retire it.
    migrate to: SHA-256 or SHA-3
      gateway/jwt.go:6   "crypto/sha1"
      gateway/jwt.go:10   _ = sha1.New()

  MD5  (1 occurrence)
    Collisions are practical today. Quantum is not the problem here.
    migrate to: SHA-256 or SHA-3, or BLAKE2 for non-compliance use
      service/tokens.py:6   etag = hashlib.md5(b"body").hexdigest()


REVIEW               reduced margin under Grover, usually acceptable

  SHA-256  (1 occurrence)
    Grover gives a quadratic speedup only. Still acceptable.
    migrate to: no action needed
      gateway/cache.go:3   import "crypto/sha256"
